stations.service_boundary: Closed qualified metallization, photolithography and lift-off service only. No solvents, deposition, heating, sonication or exposure actuation.

stations.service_boundary: Closed qualified nanotube growth, electron-beam lithography, evaporation and AFM service. No gases, high temperature, vacuum, chemical or beam controls.

stations.service_boundary: Closed qualified die attachment, bond and sample-holder assembly service; generic record anchors, no bond toolpaths or heating recipe.

stations.service_boundary: Distinct fixed-load, SQD and DQD circuit cards. No live wiring changes; DQD series-capacitor topology explicit. RF/DC anchors are schematic metadata only.

stations.service_boundary: Closed qualified cryogenic service; no refrigerator, pressure, cooldown, warmup or electrical commands. Independent safe release is required for module removal.

stations.service_boundary: Separate reference plane, line attenuation/gain, noise, equivalent bandwidth and device baselines. Commanded settings are not observed calibration.
